node.name: Transformation t
node.name_en: Transformation to modal form using eigenvectors

definition: Transformation t：The transformation matrix T is composed of the eigenvectors of A. The transformed system matrices are A_m = T^{-1} A T,…
intuition: 在图谱邻接中可把握：后续 → Eigenvector、Modal form。
explanation: The transformation matrix T is composed of the eigenvectors of A. The transformed system matrices are A_m = T^{-1} A T, B_m = T^{-1} B, C_m = C T, D_m = D.
